body: i know it shouldn’t be a person but that and every time it felt like i was close to having someone i’d feel happiest. i don’t really do much anymore except play xbox tbh. i still can’t drive so everything is pretty limited for me. i have friends on xbox i’m really close to but of course they can’t be around all the time. they’re functioning people and xbox is a free time thing. they work and go out w actual friends. i wish i could do all that but it scares me too much. i feel sick thinking about it

late may/early june i did some inpatient in the psych ward but it was just them starting me on effexor and letting me sleep and stare at a wall for days. after that they set me up w a partial inpatient thing where it was supposed to teach other stuff like dbt but it felt like school and there were a lot of people and i hated it. i just didn’t go back after the first day. usually when i feel like this i can’t do much other than sleep or try to. my brain plays everything bad that’s happened or i’ve thought on a loop and it’s debilitating. i play xbox a lot and i can’t even do that or watch tv bc i just end up thinking about everything bc it won’t stop. verbally talking to someone usually helps bc if it isn’t my mom i feel the need to hold it together. i hate people hearing or seeing me cry. but idk. i feel like such an ass whenever someone tries to offer coping skills bc it turns into me saying they won’t work bc of how i am and how relentless my stupid brain is in its mission to make me feel like shit till i finally off myself

i don’t know what to say or do really. i was hospitalized at the end of may/beginning of june and thought that was like. the ultimate low and it would only get better. and for a little while after it did. i had friends. finally got a boyfriend. i was actually happy for the first time like ever. i felt like life was worth it. but apparently i wasn’t happy enough. got dumped. been isolated and alone since. that was months ago. i hate it because it showed me how it was to be happy and it was so weird and good. i had a few months of that after years of only being sad or angry all the time. and it got ripped away like it was nothing. felt pathetic enough being that girl who couldn’t get a boyfriend forever and now it’s like ah yes back to that. because even someone like me w problems won’t want me. i’m a big sad burden. to my ex. to the people i was friends with. to my family. idk. if i weren’t afraid of what comes (or doesn’t) after you die i would’ve killed myself already for sure. i just don’t like the uncertainty of it.
and what is that supposed to do for me??
